chunks: And the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Every preacher is a qiblah, and every one being preached to is a qiblah for the preacher."

key_terms.اَلنَّبِيُّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.قِبْلَةٌ: a focal point or direction toward which one turns
key_terms.مَوْعُوظٍ: one who is being admonished or exhorted
key_terms.وَاعِظٍ: one who gives admonition or moral counsel

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم mean by saying that every preacher and listener is a qiblah for one another?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a reciprocal relationship between the one who gives admonition and the one who receives it. It highlights the mutual orientation, attentiveness, and moral significance of both teaching and being taught in religious counsel.
